files.docker-compose.yml:
version: '3.9'

services:
  postgres:
    image: pgvector/pgvector:pg16
    environment:
      POSTGRES_USER: ${{{ env_prefix }}_DB_USER:-app}
      POSTGRES_PASSWORD: ${{{ env_prefix }}_DB_PASSWORD:-dev}
      POSTGRES_DB: ${{{ env_prefix }}_DB_NAME:-appdb}
    ports: ['5432:5432']
    volumes: ['postgres_data:/var/lib/postgresql/data']

  redis:
    image: redis:7-alpine
    ports: ['6379:6379']

  auth:
    build: ./services/auth
    depends_on: [postgres, redis]
    ports: ['8001:8000']
    environment:
      DATABASE_URL: postgresql+asyncpg://app:dev@postgres:5432/appdb
      REDIS_URL: redis://redis:6379

  users:
    build: ./services/users
    depends_on: [postgres]
    ports: ['8002:8000']

  notifications:
    build: ./services/notifications
    depends_on: [redis]
    ports: ['8003:8000']

  gateway:
    image: nginx:1.25-alpine
    volumes:
      - ./infra/nginx/nginx.conf:/etc/nginx/nginx.conf:ro
    ports: ['80:80']
    depends_on: [auth, users, notifications]

volumes:
  postgres_data:
files..env.example:
# Microservices environment variables
# Prefix: {{ env_prefix }}_

{{ env_prefix }}_DB_USER=app
{{ env_prefix }}_DB_PASSWORD=changeme
{{ env_prefix }}_DB_NAME=appdb
{{ env_prefix }}_JWT_SECRET=changeme-32-char-min
{{ env_prefix }}_REDIS_URL=redis://localhost:6379
